name: withPICA
description:
withPICA organizes and manages your whole music catalogue in one place — your works, recordings, credits, splits, rights, and royalties.

bring your songs in from the sources you already use: Spotify and YouTube links, spreadsheets, photos of liner notes, even DAW sessions. withPICA builds them into one structured, searchable catalog and fills the gaps for you — looking up your ISWCs, ISRCs, publisher data, and collaborator ids from MLC, MusicBrainz, ISNI, and Spotify. you review everything before it's saved.

from there you can verify credits and splits, establish ownership, track royalties and statements, share a single source of truth with your collaborators, and export registration-ready files for your PRO (performing rights organization) or a full catalog asset report. every well-catalogued work gets equal discoverability in the public directory.

music catalogue management, metadata, rights, and royalties — clear, accurate, and yours.

_published_faq.name: How do I add withPICA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add withPICA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://withpica.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the withPICA MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: withPICA provides these MCP tools: pica_discover, pica_execute, and pica_tool_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to withPICA?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to withPICA in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
withPICA requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
withPICA is developed by withpica ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
